descripcion: Greetings and introductions · Where you are from, work and languages
Numbers and family · The house and things
Daily routine, separable verbs, telling the time, the days of the week and how often.
What you like, ordering in a café and quantities.
Clothes, demonstratives, prices and comparing.
Places, directions, transport and modal verbs.
Hobbies, the weather, dates, plans and invitations.
«War» and «hatte», the Perfekt, the hotel and health.
Parts of the body and complaints, dative pronouns, prepositions with the dative and advice with «sollen».
Feminine job titles, verbs with prepositions and «würde» and «könnte» for polite requests.
Place prepositions with the dative and accusative, possessives and the home.
Sentences with «weil», «dass», «wenn» and «obwohl».
Comparative, superlative and «so… wie».
Präteritum of «sein», «haben» and the modal verbs, and regular and irregular verbs.
Dative and accusative with two objects, dates and time prepositions.
Future with «werden», reflexive verbs and quotes.
Relative clauses in the nominative and accusative.
«man», indefinite pronouns, «deshalb» and «trotzdem», and final test.
Time clauses with «nachdem», «bevor», «während», «bis» and «seitdem», and the past perfect.
Unreal conditionals with «wenn … hätte», «würde» and «wäre», and advice with «an deiner Stelle».
Present and past process passive, how it differs from the stative passive, and the verb «lassen».
Verbs with prepositions and pronominal adverbs, the reflexive dative and «brauchen … zu».
Infinitive with «zu», «um … zu», «ohne … zu», «statt … zu» and «damit».
Relative clauses with prepositions and in the dative, and the relative pronouns «was» and «wo».
The genitive, the prepositions «wegen», «trotz» and «während», and the declension of weak masculine nouns.
Linking words of consequence and contrast, and pairs like «sowohl … als auch» and «weder … noch».
Adjective endings in all four cases, comparatives, superlatives and modal particles.
The future with «werden», assumptions, review of the tenses and final test.
Indirect speech with Konjunktiv I: reporting what someone else said, and the forms sei, habe and werde.
Stative passive, constructions with «sich lassen» and «sein + zu + infinitive» as a passive alternative.
Nominalization and verbalization, and the modal verbs of assumption.
Participles used as adjectives and infinitives with «um … zu» and «anstatt … zu».
Sentences with «je … desto», appositions and the infinitive in general statements.
Adjective endings in depth and the linking words «sofern» and «insofern».
Linking words «zumal», «indem», «solange», «sobald» and «als ob».
Past Konjunktiv II, indirect speech in the past and «anstatt dass».
Passive with modal verbs, Perfekt («ist … worden»), dative passive and formal alternatives.
Opinion texts: «zum einen … zum anderen», advantages and disadvantages, and final test.
